continuityEvidence.evidence: Exact 40 kg modified hand-applied plaster; ГОСТ 33083-2014; cement/lime/fractional sand/additives; indoor/outdoor wall use. Wording/application/standard match the current pack closely, but the product page does not call it M-150.
continuityEvidence.technicalProfile: Average 15–17 kg/m² per 10 mm; recommended 10–20 mm, locally up to 50 mm; work temperature +5…+25 °C; compressive strength up to 5 MPa.

continuityEvidence.evidence: Separately lists modified plaster 40 kg, standard universal M-150 40 kg, and modified universal M-150 40 kg. Current official catalog therefore does not identify these product names as interchangeable.

The exact M-150 modified universal 40 kg product is under ГОСТ 31357-2007 and is designated for plastering, masonry/installation and floors; it is a distinct documented identity from the current modified plaster page.

Calls a 40 kg machine-applied plaster M-150 and lists ГОСТ 33083-2014; reports 15–20 mm and 17–18 kg/m² per 10 mm, differing from current official modified plaster page. It does not prove that the current manual-only package is its successor.
